mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly defines a subset?

options.A: Set A is a subset of set B if A and B have at least one element in common.
options.B: Set A is a subset of set B if every element of A is also an element of B.
options.C: Set A is a subset of set B if B contains at least one element that is not in A.
options.D: Set A is a subset of set B only when A and B are identical.

mcqs.answer: Set A is a subset of set B if every element of A is also an element of B.
mcqs.explanation: A subset requires that each element of the first set appears in the second set. Option B states this precisely. Option A confuses "common" with "all". Option C describes a superset condition, and Option D describes equality, not the general subset relation.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes a proper subset?

options.A: Set A is a proper subset of set B if every element of A is in B and A may be equal to B.
options.B: Set A is a proper subset of set B if A contains at least one element that B does not contain.
options.C: Set A is a proper subset of set B if every element of A is in B and A is not equal to B.
options.D: Set A is a proper subset of set B only when B has exactly one more element than A.

mcqs.answer: Set A is a proper subset of set B if every element of A is in B and A is not equal to B.
mcqs.explanation: A proper subset must satisfy the subset condition and be strictly smaller; it cannot be equal to the superset. Option C captures both requirements. Option A omits the strict inequality, Option B reverses the relationship, and Option D adds an unnecessary numeric condition.

mcqs.learning_point: Determine whether one set is a subset of another
mcqs.question: Let A = {1, 2, 3}, B = {1, 2, 3, 4}, and C = {2, 4}. Which of the following statements is true?

options.A: A is a subset of B.
options.B: B is a subset of A.
options.C: C is a subset of A.

mcqs.answer: A is a subset of B.
mcqs.explanation: Every element of A (1,2,3) appears in B, so A ⊂ B is true. B is not a subset of A because it has element 4 not in A. C is not a subset of A because element 4 is missing from A. Hence only statement A is correct.

mcqs.learning_point: Find subsets of a finite set
mcqs.question: How many distinct subsets does the set S = {a, b, c, d} have?
mcqs.explanation: A set with n elements has 2^n subsets. Here n = 4, so 2^4 = 16 subsets. Options A, B, and D are incorrect because they correspond to 2^3, 12 (no power of two), and 2^4 + 4 respectively.
